title: Holiday Lights Tour with LACMA Urban Light Stop
includes: Visit to Hollywood, Beverly Hills, Melrose and more
See the beauty of Rodeo Drive in Beverly Hills
Visit to Sunset Strip, West Hollywood
Free Sweet Treat for the Holidays
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller

cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
See the city’s most spectacular Christmas light displays.

Begin your tour in Hollywood, where iconic locations are decked out for the holidays. Get into the holiday spirit while learning about the history of famous filming locations, celebrity haunts, and world-renowned attractions.

Next, head to the legendary Sunset Strip. View where Hollywood elite and celebrities of today shop, eat, perform, and socialize. Tour past locales like the Comedy Store where many famous comedians got their start.

Continue to Beverly Hills and see the best of the area as you pass the iconic Beverly Hills Sign, the famous Beverly Wilshire Hotel from Pretty Woman, and Rodeo Drive, lined with palm trees, holiday lights, and luxury boutiques.

Enjoy LA’s most beloved destinations, the Farmer’s Market and the Grove, and marvel at its total holiday transformation. Take pictures of the grand Christmas tree and smile at the “snowfalls” in front of Santa’s house.
